summary: LibreKB is a web-based application designed for creating and organising knowledge bases. It operates as a straightforward PHP and MySQL web app that can be hosted on standard hosting environments.
goodFor: It suits administrators who need a simple, self-hosted documentation tool and already maintain a conventional PHP and MySQL web server stack.
watchOut: With low repository engagement and infrequent tagged releases, ongoing maintenance, security updates, and bug fixes may rely heavily on your own intervention.
deployNotes: You will typically need a standard web server with PHP support, a connected MySQL database, and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
